input: Synthetic input. Fields: item_id (string), condition (string). Notes: item_id means ‘Inventory identifier.’ condition means ‘Recorded condition’ and must be new or used; the note says this list is exhaustive. Samples: item_id=I-1, condition=used. Null and blank meanings are not supplied.

fields.source_wording: Recorded condition; must be new or used, and the list is exhaustive.
fields.normalized_definition: Recorded condition of the inventory item.

unresolved_questions: What do null and blank values mean for item_id and condition?
